resources_mentioned.name: Getting to a Million
resources_mentioned.context: Greg Roeder's book on building a seven-figure real estate practice.

episode_summary: In this episode, Greg Roeder shares how he grew his real estate business from $12 million to $40 million by leveraging community events and targeted content. He emphasizes the importance of building genuine relationships and creating niche-specific content to avoid being an 'invisible agent.' Greg also discusses the significance of delegating tasks to maintain work-life balance while scaling up.
